summary: A local expense tracker where the user records expenses with a euro amount, a category, and a date, removes expenses after confirming, and reviews the total spent per category for the current month. Expenses persist on the device and are restored after restart.
targetUsers: Individuals who want a simple personal record of their monthly spending by category
goals: Record expenses with an amount in euros, a category, and a date
Remove an expense only after the user confirms
Show the total spent per category for the current month
Keep expenses on the device and restore them after restart

features.name: Add expense
features.userOutcome: The user records a new expense with an amount, a category, and a date.
features.trigger: The user chooses to add an expense.
features.behavior: A form collects an amount in euros with two decimals, a category chosen from Food, Rent, Travel, or Other, and a date. The amount must be greater than zero and is entered with two decimals; the form rejects a missing amount, a missing category, or a missing date. The category list starts at Food. The date starts at today. Saving creates the expense record and returns to the expense list.
features.failureOutcome: If the expense cannot be saved, the form stays open with the entered values and shows that the expense was not saved.
acceptanceSignals: Saving a valid form writes a record whose amount, category, and date read back from the store match the entered values.
Submitting with an empty amount, no category, or no date leaves the form open and creates no record.
A newly opened add form shows Food as the selected category and today as the date.

features.name: Expense list
features.userOutcome: The user sees all recorded expenses and can open one to view it.
features.trigger: The user opens the app or returns to the expense list.
features.behavior: Shows every stored expense ordered newest first by date, then newest first by creation time. Each row shows the amount in euros with two decimals, the category, and the date written as YYYY-MM-DD. Selecting a row shows that expense read-only with a Delete button. When no expenses exist, the list shows 'No expenses yet'. The list loads stored expenses when the app starts; if that load fails, the list shows one message that expenses could not be loaded.
features.failureOutcome: If stored expenses cannot be loaded, the list shows that expenses could not be loaded and no rows.
acceptanceSignals: With three stored expenses, the list shows them newest first by date, then newest first by creation time.
Selecting a row shows that expense read-only with a Delete button.
With no stored expenses, the list shows 'No expenses yet'.
A record read back from the store after restart shows its saved amount, category, and date.

features.name: Delete expense
features.userOutcome: The user removes an expense after confirming.
features.trigger: The user chooses Delete on the read-only view of an expense.
features.behavior: Asks for confirmation with a message naming the expense, for example Delete "12.50 Food"?, with the label Delete. Confirming removes the expense from storage and returns to the expense list; cancelling keeps the expense unchanged.
features.failureOutcome: If the expense cannot be removed, the read-only view stays open and shows that the expense was not deleted.
acceptanceSignals: Confirming the dialog removes the record so it no longer appears in the list.
Cancelling the dialog leaves the record in the store unchanged.

features.name: Monthly category totals
features.userOutcome: The user sees how much was spent in each category during the current month.
features.trigger: The user opens the totals view.
features.behavior: For the current calendar month, sums the amounts of stored expenses per category and shows one line per category that has expenses, ordered Food, Rent, Travel, Other. Each total is written in euros with two decimals, for example 42.50 EUR. When the current month has no expenses, the view shows 'No expenses this month' and no totals.
features.failureOutcome: If stored expenses cannot be read, the view shows that totals could not be loaded and no totals.
acceptanceSignals: For expenses of 10.00 Food and 5.50 Food dated in the current month, the Food total reads 15.50 EUR.
An expense dated in the previous month is not included in the current month totals.
With no expenses in the current month, the view shows 'No expenses this month'.

dataObjects.name: Expenses
dataObjects.purpose: Stores each recorded expense with its amount, category, and date.
dataObjects.retentionIntent: Kept on the device until the user deletes the expense.

qualityRequirements: Amounts are always displayed in euros with two decimals.
Expenses remain available after the app restarts.
productConstraints: Categories are limited to Food, Rent, Travel, and Other.
An expense amount must be greater than zero.
